title: Aachener Straße, Düsseldorf
description:
The room is offered as a temporary sublet for the month of February. 

Looking for a fully furnished room in Düsseldorf without the hassle of buying furniture, setting up utilities or cleaning plans?
Welcome to your new temporary home – perfect for professionals, interns, PhD students or international guests.

This freshly renovated 2-bedroom flatshare offers you:
	•	Your own private, fully furnished room
	•	Shared kitchen, bathroom and hallway
	•	A private balcony (with seating)
	•	A peaceful, well-maintained apartment in a quiet but well-connected neighbourhood

Included amenities:
	•	Bed (140 cm), wardrobe, desk, chair, nightstand, lamp, carpet
	•	Bed linen, towels, laundry basket, hangers
	•	Fully equipped kitchen: fridge, oven, stove, dishwasher, Nespresso machine, toaster, water kettle, pots, pans, dishes, glasses, cutlery, and cooking utensils
	•	Washing machine (brand new)
	•	Cleaning supplies, vacuum cleaner, iron & ironing board

Extra service:

A professional cleaning team cleans the entire apartment including your room every 2 weeks – so you don’t have to worry about it.
Cleaning fee: €71.40 per month.

Rental options:
	•	Green Room (16 m2): €770 all-in rent + cleaning (currently rented)
	•	Beige Room (19 m2 + balcony): €870 all-in rent + cleaning

The all-in rent covers utilities (heating, water, electricity, WiFi), furniture, kitchen equipment & a welcome starter pack (coffee, tea, salt, sugar).
No extra costs. No hassle.

Location highlights:
	•	5 min walk to University Hospital
	•	10–15 min to Heinrich Heine University
	•	Tram stop right in front – 15 min to city centre
	•	Supermarkets, pharmacy, cafés and restaurants within walking distance
	•	Weekly flea & farmers market around the corner
	•	Local favourites: Baristarei (best coffee & brownies) and Eisdiele Unbehau’n

title: Kölner Straße, Neuss
description: Location: The flat is centrally located, close to the city center of Neuss and Düsseldorf. Good "Autobahn" connection (A46 and A59) will allow you to be in 20 minutes in Cologne or Krefeld. Düsseldorf city center or Neuss center can be reach by car, bike or public near-by transportation. The beautiful apartment is located in the middle of Neuss - Gnadental. The vicinity offers good after work opportunties. The near river Rhine offers spacious area for walks, bike rides or other outdoor activities. Apartment. The apartment was built in Sept 2017. It includes a bedroom (double size), bathroom with shower and bath, hallway as well as living room with adjoining modern kitchen. It is floor-heated, bright and friendly. During the summer, a large terrace and a related lawn invites you to make use of the outside area. Of course, the apartment is furnished. Car parking is usually available on the main street. ......

title: Macherscheider Straße, Neuss
description:
DEUTSCHE Beschreibung folgt weiter unten. 
Stylish, Fully Furnished and Newly Renovated Temporary Apartment – Move-in Ready Living with garden & Parking Space
Welcome to your new temporary home: This high-quality, fully furnished apartment combines modern design, a warm living atmosphere, and thoughtfully selected features for comfortable stays between 4 and 12 months.
The apartment is a first occupancy after a complete core renovation, including all new plumbing, triple-glazed windows, and extensive professional interior thermal insulation.
It is ideally suited for business commuters, project professionals, expats, or anyone seeking a premium temporary housing solution.
________________________________________
Apartment Highlights
•	Fully and newly furnished & completely move-in ready 
•	Temporary rental for 4 to 12 months 
•	Private 8 m2 terrace 
•	Shared garden access 
•	Outdoor parking space included 
•	Exclusive additional access to the garden and parking space through a second private entrance door 
•	Modern bathroom with spacious walk-in shower 
•	High-quality fitted kitchen by Nobilia 
•	Quiet and stylish atmosphere 
•	Ready for immediate occupancy 
________________________________________
House Rules
•	Non-smoking apartment with permanently installed smoke detector 
•	No pets allowed 
________________________________________
Living Area
The spacious living and dining area features a modern sofa, stylish lighting, Smart TV, and a cozy dining space. Large windows provide plenty of natural daylight and create a bright and welcoming atmosphere.
________________________________________
Kitchen
The modern fitted kitchen is fully equipped and offers everything needed for everyday living, including:
•	Fast-heating cooktop 
•	Elevated oven 
•	Siemens dishwasher 
•	Fully automatic coffee machine 
•	Washer-dryer combination machine 
Perfect for relaxed and hassle-free living.
________________________________________
Bedroom
The quiet bedroom features a comfortable double bed with two separate mattresses, high-quality furniture, and ample storage space. The tasteful interior design creates a pleasant living experience, even for extended stays.
________________________________________
Bathroom
The timeless modern bathroom is equipped with a nearly floor-level shower, premium fittings, and elegant details. Brands such as Villeroy & Boch, Grohe, and Vigour reflect the apartment’s high-quality standards.
________________________________________
Outdoor Area
The apartment includes a private terrace as well as shared use of the garden — ideal for relaxing after work. A private outdoor parking space is also available.
________________________________________
Rental Period
The apartment is exclusively offered for temporary stays ranging from 4 to 12 months.
________________________________________
Additional Information
The apartment is fully equipped (“move in and feel at home”) and is especially suitable for tenants seeking a high-quality and uncomplicated temporary living solution.
If interested, we look forward to receiving your inquiry including a short introduction and your preferred rental period.
You are also welcome to provide proof of income and a SCHUFA credit report.
